market.advice: Risk-off rotation is in control: SPY is below its 50- and 200-day, there's no follow-through day, oil is spiking on Middle East escalation and 10-yr yields sit near January-2025 highs. Money is fleeing high-multiple tech (TSLA, MSFT, ORCL, APP, PLTR all deeply off their highs) and crowding into defensives — industrials, financials, REITs, healthcare and energy. Trade selectively, smaller size, and only take A+ setups at or breaking to new highs. Let leadership prove itself before adding beta.
